blocking: Desktop hero (index-desktop-0): the arch window's 2px cream outline runs behind the cream wordmark and the letters 'AR EV' sit on near-white video (white sculpture, glass, pale hydrangea); the hard rule 'big cream wordmark readable over the video' is only just met and the cream-on-cream line crossing the letters reads as a collision, not a poster
Palette drift: --red is #9E1B32 (burgundy) and --seed #E8243F, not the book's #D10C0C; every rule, eyebrow, dot, button and the header wordmark are off-brand red site-wide

fixes.what: Set --red:#D10C0C; drop --seed or alias it to #D10C0C; confirm assets/logo/logo-red.svg fill is #D10C0C
fixes.why: The brand book names one red; burgundy makes the whole cream build look like a different studio

fixes.what: Cap the window so its foot clears the wordmark: max-height:calc(100svh - 10vh - 8vh - min(92vw,1100px)*0.345 - 32px); and add filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 14px rgba(67,38,23,.55)) to the wordmark img and .logo-morph__cream

fixes.what: Raise BRANCH_MAX to ~40vh and add a slow 8s ±1.2deg rotate/sway tween (paused under reduced motion) on each branch
fixes.why: In desktop shots 1–3 the branches sit in exactly the same spot; they read as stuck watermarks, not living art

fixes.what: Remove .site-footer border-top (the ground band already separates CTA and footer); set .site-footer__bottom border to the 2px cream kashida rule at .25 opacity
fixes.why: The 1px seam between brown CTA and brown ground band is a grid hairline the brand forbids

fixes.what: Phone: move window top to 12vh so it clears the header, and give .hero__tag a text-shadow:0 1px 6px rgba(67,38,23,.6) or keep it on one line by hiding the Persian half at <400px
fixes.why: index-phone-0: the arch kisses the header row and the two-line mixed-script tagline on raw video looks cramped

fixes.what: Thicken the inset frame to 2px and colour the kashida-tagline rules amber (var(--amber)) on brown
fixes.why: On brown the brand accent is amber; the poster currently uses cream only and its 1px frame is a hairline
